name: write
description: Write a file to the local filesystem. Overwrites the file if it already exists. file_path must be absolute. Prefer the `edit` tool for modifying existing files — only use `write` to create new files or for full rewrites. Do NOT create documentation/README files unless explicitly requested.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Required absolute path to the file to write.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Required full content to write. Replaces the file's existing contents entirely.
